_meta.title: TLDR Astro Content Library
_meta.voice: App voice per astro-voice-guide.md — the BLEND of the two source voices below, not a copy of either.

voiceSources.words: ALL copy comes from the author's own write-ups: 2025-2026 lunar-calendar.ics, 2026 Astro Calendar (author's entries), the Astro Guide, and the Weekly Emotional Moon. This is the only source of wording.
voiceSources.chani: STYLE reference ONLY — never a source of words. CHANI's calendar shows a target register (short, warm, practical, present-tense). Match the brevity and warmth; do not lift or paraphrase CHANI's lines.
voiceSources.rule: Write in the author's voice. Distill the author's own long entries (rituals, tarot, intentions-by-rising) into the app card — never copy CHANI.

_meta.source: Derived from uploaded files; no astronomy stored here — that comes from the ephemeris/.ics at resolve time.
_meta.usage: The resolver (resolveDay.js) reads this + a day's ephemeris state and assembles the AstroDay object (astro-day.schema.json).

phaseReads._note: Cycle-aware, guided by the lunar-calendar.ics phase logic (First Quarter = work the intention, Last Quarter = release, Full = harvest the axis) but rewritten to app length. On the two checkpoint phases (First/Last Quarter) the resolver uses `fallback` for the moon card fallback and PREPENDS the filled `frame` to the sign writeup, so a phase day reads differently from a plain sign day. `frame` templates fill {sign}, {oppositeSign}, {newMoonSign}; `frameNoCycle` is used when the cycle's New Moon sign isn't known. New/Full get their own lunation card (see lunationFraming), so their fallbacks here are only used if that card is suppressed.

New Moon.fallback: A clean slate in {sign}. Plant the intention before you rush to act on it.
New Moon.frame: A new {sign} cycle opens — whatever you set now shows itself by the {oppositeSign} Full Moon.

Waxing Crescent.fallback: The seed's in the ground. Protect it while it's still small.

First Quarter.fallback: First resistance, right on cue. Adjust the plan, not the intention.
First Quarter.frame: What you planted at the {newMoonSign} New Moon meets its first friction now — {sign} wants action, not admiration.
First Quarter.frameNoCycle: What you set in motion meets its first friction now — {sign} wants action, not admiration.

Waxing Gibbous.fallback: Almost there. Refine it instead of forcing it.

Full Moon.fallback: Everything's lit. See what's grown before you decide what to release.
Full Moon.frame: The {sign}–{oppositeSign} axis lights up — see what's grown since the {sign} New Moon, and release the rest.

Waning Gibbous.fallback: The peak has passed. Share what you learned; let the rest settle.

Last Quarter.fallback: The cycle's winding down. Time to release what didn't serve.
Last Quarter.frame: As this cycle closes, {sign} asks what you're keeping out of fear instead of purpose.
Last Quarter.frameNoCycle: As this cycle closes, {sign} asks what you're keeping out of fear instead of purpose.

Waning Crescent.fallback: Empty out. Rest is the assignment now.

Aries.fallback: The urge to move is louder than the plan. Trust it — just aim it.
Aries.writeup: You might be done waiting for a green light that was never coming. The Moon in Aries makes the body restless and the yes-or-no obvious. Notice whether you're moving toward what you want or just away from discomfort. Either way, you're allowed to start before you feel ready.

Taurus.fallback: Your body knows what your mind keeps arguing with. Slow down and ask it.
Taurus.writeup: The Moon in Taurus pulls everything back to earth — slower, quieter, more physical. What felt urgent an hour ago might just be a nervous system that skipped rest. Let pleasure count as a reason, not a reward. You're allowed to move at your own pace while everyone else sprints.
Taurus.mantra: Rushing feels wrong because it is.

Gemini.fallback: The mind speeds up when a feeling gets too close. Say the simple thing.
Gemini.writeup: The Moon in Gemini scatters your attention across a dozen open tabs. Some of it is curiosity; some is avoidance wearing curiosity's coat. Before you gather more information, ask what you already know and haven't said. You're allowed to not have every answer before you start the conversation.
Gemini.mantra: Say what you mean, mean what you say.

Cancer.fallback: You're feeling more than you're letting on. That's information, not weakness.
Cancer.writeup: The Moon is home in Cancer, and so are your tender spots — the old need, the unspoken hurt, the care that's run one direction too long. Protect your energy like the resource it is. Feel what's here without narrating it into a problem. You're allowed to have needs that inconvenience other people.
Cancer.mantra: Your sensitivity is data, not weakness.

Leo.fallback: You don't have to be 'on' to be seen. Warm lands harder than bright.
Leo.writeup: The Moon in Leo wants you visible, but there's a difference between shining and performing. If the confidence feels like a costume today, you're allowed to set it down and be magnificent in a quieter key. Create from joy, not from proof. The people worth impressing are moved by the real you.
Leo.mantra: Be seen as you are, not as you should be.

Virgo.fallback: The urge to fix everything is often fear with a to-do list. Be gentle.
Virgo.writeup: The Moon in Virgo hands you a magnifying glass, and every flaw lights up. Some of that eye is care; some is self-punishment in a tidy disguise. Sort what genuinely needs tending from what only needs accepting. You're allowed to be a work in progress, and to rest before you've earned it.

Libra.fallback: Keeping the peace isn't the same as making it. Your voice counts too.
Libra.writeup: The Moon in Libra makes every imbalance visible — the favors never returned, the compromises that are always yours. This isn't a call to start a fight, just to stop avoiding the truth that's causing the tension. Real harmony includes what you need. You're allowed to stop being the only one who adjusts.
Libra.mantra: Truth before peace, authenticity before approval.

Scorpio.fallback: Everything feels intense because it is. You don't have to numb it or fix it.
Scorpio.writeup: The Moon slips into Scorpio and the surface stops being enough. What you've been managing — the want, the grief, the truth under the polite version — asks to be felt instead of handled. None of it needs solving today. Let what's ready to end, end, and don't carry the rest any further than you have to.
Scorpio.mantra: Feel it all, judge none of it.

Sagittarius.fallback: The life you're living might be smaller than the one you're becoming.
Sagittarius.writeup: The Moon in Sagittarius makes the walls obvious — the small talk, the manufactured problems, the comfort you've outgrown. The pull toward something bigger isn't restlessness to manage; it's direction. You don't have to burn it all down today, just admit what's already over. You're allowed to want more than you have.

Capricorn.fallback: Before you climb any harder, check whose mountain this actually is.
Capricorn.writeup: The Moon in Capricorn makes the weight obvious — every should, every metric that has nothing to do with what you value. Some of it is yours to carry; some you picked up for other people. Set it down without calling it failure. You're allowed to build on your own terms, or to build nothing today.

Aquarius.fallback: Stepping back isn't coldness. It's the clearest seat in the room.
Aquarius.writeup: The Moon in Aquarius cools the noise and lets you see the pattern everyone else is too deep in to notice. Detachment is a gift today, though it can tip into loneliness if you forget you're part of what you're watching. Zoom out to get clear, then step back in. You're allowed to care without drowning in it.
Aquarius.mantra: Observe the pattern, don't become it.

Pisces.fallback: Logic clocked out early. That might be exactly what today needs.
Pisces.writeup: The Moon in Pisces softens the edges between thinking and feeling, real and possible. You're processing more than you can name, so energy runs low and focus slips. Don't force it into sense. Let intuition lead where analysis stalls. You're allowed to not have it figured out, and to rest while it works itself through.
Pisces.mantra: Trust the mystery, release the need to know.

Aries.fallback: The astrological year restarts. You don't need it all figured out to begin.
Aries.writeup: Aries season calls you into motion and burns off whatever no longer fits who you're becoming. The confrontation isn't with other people — it's with your own habit of playing small. Trust the instinct before you've built the case for it. This is a month to initiate, not to wait for permission.

Taurus.fallback: Slow down and decide what's actually worth your time.
Taurus.writeup: Taurus season asks you back into your body and your senses. Value isn't the same as cost, and stillness isn't the same as stuck. Choose rituals over routines, depth over distraction, what sustains you over what merely impresses. This is a month to build slowly and let yourself feel supported enough to grow.

Gemini.fallback: Say what you mean. The world is listening more closely than you think.
Gemini.writeup: Gemini season lights up curiosity, conversation, and the thrill of a new idea. You don't have to choose one path — this is a month to explore many. Just watch the line between gathering information and avoiding a decision. Say the thing you've been circling. Your words are spells, so cast them honestly.

Cancer.fallback: Come home to yourself — the one you've been building inside your chest.
Cancer.writeup: Cancer season reconnects you to the emotional body and the need to feel safe. This is a month for deep feeling, protective boundaries, and nurturing what matters most. Soft doesn't mean weak. Build sanctuary wherever you are, and trust that your emotions are carrying information. Care for yourself without shame or apology.
Cancer.mantra: Soft is not the same as weak.

Leo.fallback: Welcome to the season that wants the lights on.
Leo.writeup: Leo season hands everyone a month of warm, expressive, spotlight-seeking energy. This is the time to remember who you are at your core: to create, to play, to lead with heart. Channel the passion into purpose rather than performance. Crown yourself with intention, then spend the light on the part of your life that's been waiting.
Leo.mantra: Light is love with the lights on.

Virgo.fallback: Virgo season isn't here to fix you. It's here to return you to what's sacred.
Virgo.writeup: Virgo season is devotion in the small things — the daily rituals and habits that repair your nervous system. This isn't about proving you're broken; it's about tending what supports you. Align your routines with your intentions and let self-care be the medicine. A month for precision offered as kindness, not criticism.

Libra.fallback: This season shows where you've kept things nice at your own expense.
Libra.writeup: Libra season turns attention to relationships, beauty, and fairness. It reveals where the scales have quietly tipped against you — where 'it's fine' was never true. Peace comes through honesty, not silence. This is a month to bring your connections back into real balance, honoring your individuality without abandoning the people in them.

Scorpio.fallback: What's been hidden wants to surface. Let it.
Scorpio.writeup: Scorpio season is the power of transformation — shedding what no longer serves to reclaim your strength. It asks for emotional honesty and the courage to face what you've been hiding from yourself. This is a month of first frost and things breaking through decay. Trust the cycle of death and rebirth. Let what's ready to go, go.
Scorpio.mantra: Let what needs to die, die.

Sagittarius.fallback: You're the author. What story do you actually want to tell?
Sagittarius.writeup: Sagittarius season expands the horizon and hungers for meaning beyond the immediate. This is a month to speak your truth, ask the big questions, and reconnect with your inner light. Expansion begins with belief. Don't use the search for meaning to escape your life — use it to write the next honest chapter of it.

Capricorn.fallback: Build what will still matter in ten years.
Capricorn.writeup: Capricorn season is the master builder — discipline, responsibility, and structures that last. Set goals, face fears, measure your energy. Saturn asks for structure not as punishment but as foundation. This is a month for patient ambition, where today's discipline becomes tomorrow's legacy. Just make sure the mountain you're climbing is actually yours.
Capricorn.mantra: Your legacy starts with today's discipline.

Aquarius.fallback: The world needs your unique light — and your willingness to disrupt.
Aquarius.writeup: Aquarius season reminds you that you were born to question the systems, not just inherit them. This is a month for radical honesty, authentic rebellion, and thinking for the collective good. Commit to the frequency of your future self. Liberation begins with remembering what you came here to do — then leading with it instead of following.
Aquarius.mantra: You are here to be true.

Pisces.fallback: Soften the hard edges and trust what you can't yet see.
Pisces.writeup: Pisces season invites you to dissolve into trust — intuition over analysis, flow over force. This is a month to soften, dream, and let what you can't see inform your decisions. Create space for the quiet knowing that logic can't reach. Let your dreams guide the practical, and release what's ready to return to the river.

lunationFraming._note: A New/Full Moon day gets its own card. The resolver composes it from the Moon's sign (moonBySign) + this framing. Full Moon = Sun in the opposite sign; name the axis. Keep it slightly more ritual than a daily read.

New Moon.open: New Moon in {sign} — a clean slate in the territory {sign} governs.
New Moon.action: Plant the intention now; let action come later. Energy may run low, so honor the pull toward rest.

Full Moon.open: Full Moon in {sign}, opposite the Sun in {oppositeSign} — the {sign}/{oppositeSign} axis lit at once.
Full Moon.action: This is culmination and release. See what the last cycle grew, then let go of what it outgrew.
